scheme_name: Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person
other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir of the differently abled person
Differently‑abled person must have died a natural death
Differently‑abled person must have been a registered member of the Welfare Board for the Differently‑abled
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 to the legal heir of a differently‑abled person who dies a natural death.
